entities.name: Kedarick VI
entities.description: A human king of Iretis on Theros who worked toward peace with the leonin but fell to Ashiok's schemes and died by his own hand.

entities.name: Iretis
entities.description: A polis of about 10,000 residents on Theros that fell after Ashiok's schemes and became Phenax's necropolis.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where the events take place.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: Cat-like people of Theros with whom Kedarick sought peace, who march on Iretis.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who disguised themself as Kedarick's advisor Udaen and masterminded the fall of Iretis.

entities.name: Udaen
entities.description: Kedarick's real advisor, who had died two months before Ashiok took his place.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: The god of deception who watches Kedarick's death and claims Iretis to house his Returned.

entities.name: Klytessa of Meletis
entities.description: Kedarick's wife, who left Iretis with their daughter.

entities.name: Thoros Clawkiller
entities.description: Kedarick's friend and prominent expansionist who is killed after lunging at the king.

entities.name: Teralos
entities.description: Thoros's nephew, killed by a nightmare cat.

entities.name: Chelta
entities.description: One of Kedarick's bodyguards, killed by the nightmare cat.

entities.name: Vanin
entities.description: One of Kedarick's bodyguards, dragged into a cloud of darkness.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A polis that blames Kedarick and supports the leonin mission to overthrow him.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A polis that declines to aid Kedarick.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A polis that declines to aid Kedarick.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: Undead that Phenax would house in Iretis.

events.summary: Kedarick sends his advisor Udaen, secretly Ashiok, to broker the peace treaty.
events.quote: Kedarick sent his advisor Udaen to broker the treaty

events.summary: Thoros offers support for peace, then pulls his nephew's head from his satchel blaming the leonin, and lunges at Kedarick; Kedarick beheads him.
events.quote: Thoros himself was beheaded by Kedarick, his former friend.

events.summary: At the treaty signing, nightmare creatures appear and kill leonin elders and Kedarick's bodyguards.
events.quote: The bodyguard Chelta stabbed the monster's chest

events.summary: Humans and leonin slaughter each other, each believing the other betrayed them; twelve humans survive.
events.quote: the humans and Leonin had started slaughtering each other

events.summary: Meletis blames Kedarick and declares support for the leonin mission to overthrow him; Akros and Setessa decline aid.
events.quote: Meletis formally declared its support for the Leonin mission to overthrow Kedarick

events.summary: A leonin army marches on Iretis; Ashiok falsely tells Kedarick his wife and child were murdered, and Kedarick stabs out his own eyes.
events.quote: Kedarick drew his dagger and stabbed himself first in one eye, then the other

events.summary: Ashiok reveals themself as mastermind; Phenax claims Iretis for his Returned.
events.quote: Phenax would have the city to house his Returned

events.summary: Legends portray Kedarick as a hero who blinded himself rather than see his family murdered.
events.quote: quickly became a legend among storytellers

relations.quote: his beloved wife Klytessa of Meletis
the mastermind behind the fall of Kedarick
Thoros himself was beheaded by Kedarick
a human king of the polis of Iretis

relations.note: Phenax lingered as Ashiok was given free rein.
relations.quote: Ashiok was given free rein to continue their torment of the people of Theros
